schema.title: Private reader delegation protocol constants
schema.description: Protocol metadata only, never key material. Issuance modes keep distinct fixed scopes and require existing feature flags; this contract does not enable a transport or grant access.

source_text:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://anipotts.com/schemas/private-reader-v1.json",
  "title": "Private reader delegation protocol constants",
  "description": "Protocol metadata only, never key material. Issuance modes keep distinct fixed scopes and require existing feature flags; this contract does not enable a transport or grant access.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "issuer": {"$ref": "#/$defs/issuer"},
    "audience": {"$ref": "#/$defs/audience"},
    "algorithm": {"$ref": "#/$defs/algorithm"},
    "max_lifetime_seconds": {"$ref": "#/$defs/max_lifetime_seconds"},
    "data_scopes": {"$ref": "#/$defs/data_scopes"},
    "ops_scopes": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ops_scopes"},
    "health_scopes": {"$ref": "#/$defs/health_scopes"}
  },
  "$defs": {
    "data_path": {"const": "/api/private-reader/credential"},
    "ops_path": {"const": "/api/private-reader/ops-credential"},
    "health_path": {"const": "/api/private-reader/health-credential"},
    "issuer": {"const": "https://admin.anipotts.com"},
    "audience": {"const": "https://ap-mini.tail060490.ts.net"},
    "data_scopes": {"const": ["data:read", "activity:read"]},
    "ops_scopes": {"const": ["ops:read"]},
    "health_scopes": {"const": ["health:read"]},
    "algorithm": {"const": "ES256"},
    "token_type": {"const": "JWT"},
    "max_lifetime_seconds": {"const": 60},
    "max_clock_skew_seconds": {"const": 5},
    "max_authorization_header_chars": {"const": 4096},
    "max_body_bytes": {"const": 1024},
    "serve_login_header": {"const": "tailscale-user-login"},
    "required_claims": {"const": ["iss", "aud", "sub", "email", "iat", "nbf", "exp", "scope"]},
    "optional_claims": {"const": ["jti"]},
    "allowed_header_fields": {"const": ["alg", "typ", "kid"]}
  }
}
